blocks.text: You will need your own key card to get into the building over the long weekend, because the lobby doors stay locked and the front desk is unstaffed until the holiday is over. Building management sent the notice to me this morning, and since we are the two who talked about coming in to finish drafts before the new year, I wanted to be sure it reached you as well.
If your card has given you any trouble lately, it would be worth trying it at the side entrance on your way out this afternoon, while there is still someone at the desk who can issue a replacement.
